# /crav1-review-architecture

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a draft spec to an accepted spec](../../from-draft-spec.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-review-architecture/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Start the crav1-review-architecture-agent subagent on the current spec.

Run the crav1-review-architecture-agent subagent; numbered issues at the end. Optional next, not run from this command: [`/crav1-review-security`](crav1-review-security.md).

## Runs when

Spec, diagrams, or ADRs exist. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 0 (asks nothing). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: Spec, diagrams, ADRs, and export when present.

Reads `spec.md`, `diagrams.md`, `adr/`, and `export/` when those exist.

## Writes

In short: Nothing (numbered `I#`s in chat).

Writes nothing.

## Does not

Leaves the spec and code alone.

Limits and exceptions: the parent delegates the critique and does not review in its own voice. It names [`/crav1-tighten-spec`](crav1-tighten-spec.md) and [`/crav1-review-security`](crav1-review-security.md) and does not run them.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-tighten-spec`](crav1-tighten-spec.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
